_about: Public-domain John Guyse, Independent minister in London, for the Word Hoard: Jesus Christ God-Man, The Holy Spirit a Divine Person, his ordination, funeral and New Year sermons, The Scripture-Notion of Preaching Christ, Youth's Monitor, A Collection of Seventeen Practical Sermons, and The Practical Expositor of the New Testament. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 123 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
